本轮实验记录（数据集 B，第 4 轮，任务 regression）。
假设：The model cannot tell which unit a row came from, so it predicts the population-average lifetime for every unit and is wrong by the spread of lifetimes.
所做的改动：Give every unit the same total mass in the loss, so the population average stops being the objective the model is fitted to. 证伪条件：If the per-unit RMSE spread is no larger than the within-unit RMSE, the unit is not the confounder.
